svg.title: What agreement tells you
svg.desc: Two coders each mark ten answers for one code, Money. Coder A and Coder B choose the same on eight of the ten. Because most answers are no for this code, luck alone would match often, so agreement takes luck off the score and shows 0.52. It is worked out for each code separately. A second code that was used on very few answers shows no figure.

text.tspan: Most answers are "no", so luck matches often
Support: used on too few answers, no figure
Agreement counts how often two coders chose the same.
It takes luck off the score.
It is worked out for each code on its own.
